entries.4b9d1827c188c917: This service combines leasing, in which affiliates own FPSOs and FSOs and lease them to clients, with operation services in which offshore installed facilities are operated for oil and gas production, maintenance inspection and management.
entries.4f62f6f0d62d0bd1: FPSO (floating production, storage and offloading facility for offshore oil and gas)

entries.590c982a684314c1: This is a service that receives orders for the design, procurement, construction and installation of floating offshore oil and gas production facilities as a package and provides them to clients. As a fabless company with no factories or shipyards of its own, it specializes in project management such as design, procurement and construction management, and outsources construction and installation to overseas shipyards and specialist contractors.
entries.644bae49787e3a90: This service provides after-sales services, such as parts supply and engineering support for FPSOs and other facilities built and delivered to oil and gas developers, as well as management support and operation support for affiliates and jointly controlled entities.
entries.654c1d3a0ed7afdf: Government-owned or private oil and gas development companies overseas
entries.9497ed270c8d4ea9: MODEC is a company that provides floating offshore oil and gas production facilities, including FPSOs, in an integrated manner from design and construction to ownership, leasing and operation.
entries.a31086f1f9981464: This is a service that receives orders for the design, procurement, construction and installation of floating offshore oil and gas production facilities as a package and provides them to clients.
entries.d5f08ad7baede326: The group, consisting of the company, 24 subsidiaries and 21 affiliates, handles the design, construction, ownership and operation of floating production, storage and offloading facilities such as FPSOs, FSOs and TLPs used in the midstream area of offshore oil and gas production.
entries.d9d4972afda076f9: This service combines leasing, in which affiliates own FPSOs and FSOs and lease them to clients, with operation services in which offshore installed facilities are operated for oil and gas production, maintenance inspection and management. For each project, affiliates are established and operated as joint ventures with partners centered on shipping companies and general trading companies.
entries.df82ec217fad8f80: The group, consisting of the company, 24 subsidiaries and 21 affiliates, handles the design, construction, ownership and operation of floating production, storage and offloading facilities such as FPSOs, FSOs and TLPs used in the midstream area of offshore oil and gas production. The business consists of almost a single segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥717,100 million.
